leads.title: Acre Law No. 3,355 (19 December 2017, Governor Tião Viana)
leads.documents: Guarantees use of social name by transgender people in Acre
leads.detail: Signed 19 December 2017 by Governor Tião Viana; cited in Gender identity and expression section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling of 1 March 2018
leads.documents: Right of transgender person to change official name and sex by self-declaration of psychosocial identity without surgery or professional evaluation
leads.detail: Dated 1 March 2018; cited as Supreme Federal Court of Brazil decision; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Court of Justice of Acre Order No. 15/2024 (15 October 2024)
leads.documents: Legal change of name and gender on documents must be free of charge for individuals lacking financial means
leads.detail: Published 15 October 2024 by Court of Justice of Acre; cited as Order No. 15/2024; no URL visible in text

leads.title: 2025 first 'X' gender marker case - Ariel Sebastos
leads.documents: First person in Acre to obtain document marked with gender 'X'; documents that non-binary change is allowed but still requires judicial actions
leads.detail: Dated 2025, name Ariel Sebastos; cited in Gender identity and expression section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: SEASDH-MPAC cooperation agreement and booklet (29 January 2025)
leads.documents: State Secretariat for Social Assistance and Human Rights and Public Prosecutor's Office of Acre agreement to promote LGBTQ rights; launch of booklet 'What you need to know about the rights of the LGBTQIAPN+ population: Name and gender change for Trans and Travesti people'
leads.detail: Signed 29 January 2025 by SEASDH and MPAC; booklet title in Portuguese: O que você precisa saber sobre os direitos da população LGBTQIAPN+: Mudança de nome e gênero de pessoas Trans e Travestis; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Acre Decree No. 7,311 (3 August 2017, Governor Tião Viana)
leads.documents: Establishes State Council for Combating Discrimination and Promoting Rights of Lesbians, Gays, Bisexuals, Travestis, and Transsexuals to propose public policies
leads.detail: Signed 3 August 2017; cited in Discrimination protections section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Rio Branco Law No. 2389 (30 December 2020, Mayor Socorro Neri)
leads.documents: Prohibits discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in the city of Rio Branco
leads.detail: Enacted 30 December 2020 by mayor Socorro Neri; cited in Discrimination protections section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court 2019 criminalization decision
leads.documents: Discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity explicitly illegal, equated to crime of racism
leads.detail: Dated 2019; cited as Supreme Federal Court decision equating SOGI discrimination to racism; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Rio Branco Bill No. 14/2024, Federal Public Prosecutor's Office criticism and mayoral veto
leads.documents: Bill to prohibit participation of children and adolescents in LGBTQ pride parades; enforcement climate and rights machinery response
leads.detail: Approved 13 November 2024 by Rio Branco City Council 10-1, proposed by Councilman João Marcos Luz (Liberal Party), criticized by Federal Public Prosecutor's Office for perpetuating stereotypes, vetoed by then-mayor Tião Bocalom as unconstitutional; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Associação de Homossexuais do Acre homicide survey and death of Moisés Alencastro
leads.documents: Human-rights incident data: 18 murders of homosexual people recorded 2007-2018, 14 in Rio Branco; LGBTQ activist and Acre public prosecutor Moisés Alencastro found dead in apartment in Rio Branco
leads.detail: Survey period 2007-2018 by Associação de Homossexuais do Acre; death dated 22 December 2025 in Rio Branco; cited in Discrimination section; no URL visible in text
